verdict.rationale: SumUp explicitly documents sandbox merchant accounts, test cards, and 3D Secure flow simulation for online payments, plus Virtual Solo for testing in-person Cloud API reader pairing/checkout before switching to a physical reader. This directly covers end-to-end pre-live testing for in-person integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation that sandbox/Virtual Solo testing works smoothly in practice, and more detail on test coverage for offline transactions or Tap to Pay simulation.
